caption:
Lulu spent the whole weekend hammering and putting up shelves, and now the outside of her elbow twinges when she lifts a cup.

Gripping tools hard for long periods can load the tendons on the outside of the elbow. Adjusting how hard you grip and how often you rest may help.

Hybi's tip: grip only as hard as you need, choose tools with thicker handles, take regular breaks, and use a power drill when there are lots of screws.

Numb or tingly fingers, trouble lifting a cup, or no change after two weeks are worth an assessment. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios can help. Book online via the link in bio
